prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Finalize Your Companion Adoption", "Live Pet Preview", "Pet Name"]
1: ["Welcome Your Desktop Companion", "Essential Desktop Controls", "Launch Pet"]
2: ["Select Pet Art Style", "Choose the visual style for your desktop pet before selection.", "Style Presets"]
3: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion", "Mascot Intro", "Choose Your Path"]
4: ["Signing in automatically restores your existing pets and settings across devices.", "Automatic Cloud Sync"]
5: ["Generating Your Desktop Pet...", "Usually takes under 2 minutes. Your pet will automatically appear on your screen once complete."]
6: ["Shortcut Tip: Right-click your pet or press Alt+P to hide or summon them anytime.", "Quick Shortcut: Alt+P"]
7: ["For best results, upload clear, well-lit photos with a single subject facing forward.", "Photo Quality Checklist"]
8: ["Select your path now to claim a free starter accessory bundle for your pet!", "Free Starter Gift Included"]
9: ["Desktop Display & Overlay Permissions", "Confirm how your pet appears on top of desktop windows and plays audio interactions.", "Permissions Overview", "Continue to App"]

verdicts.problem: Promotes free gifts/extras and creates urgency to act now.
